nodes.description: CLCN7 encodes ClC-7, a chloride/proton antiporter that functions as a homodimer at the osteoclast ruffled border. It was described as a chloride channel when the gene was identified, and the 2001 and 2003 sources quoted below use that wording. Heterozygous missense mutations exert a dominant negative effect by incorporating mutant subunits into the dimer, impairing chloride transport. Loss-of-function (null) mutations in heterozygous state do not cause disease, confirming that the pathogenic mechanism is dominant negative rather than haploinsufficiency.
